layer_checks.conclusion: No rendered_instruction was supplied in this template example, so lexical candidate-versus-rendered comparison is not assessable. The candidate text itself is reviewed.
Each meaningful source event is grouped at event/sentence level and linked to the actual candidate stage(s); no noun-only evidence is treated as action coverage.
Checked ordering, triggers, reference frames, counts, late descriptions, branches and repeated visits.
Independently checked actual English for entry, target, complete ordered process, semantically correct ending type and scoped conditions. Generator audit fields are not accepted as proof.
Compared the actual preceding completion with the next stage entry. A landmark cue/observation is not treated as arrival at a later doorway or region.
Checked weak cuts and buried independent goals against supported boundaries.
Cross-checked L1 source coverage, L3 stage semantics and L4 handoff evidence; each event keeps the same meaning across all three layers.
